result.reason: The operative language does not achieve the preferred position: the USD floor is left blank, no mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion is provided, and the payment-obligation exception remains narrower than all Customer payment obligations. The incomplete “greater of” formulation also prevents the clause from reliably achieving even the fallback cap. In addition, the cap uses all amounts under an applicable Order Form rather than defined Fees, potentially including taxes and other deliberately excluded amounts, while the margin comment’s requested amendment to §1.5 was not made. The duplicated section number and unexplained reference to §21.4 further reduce drafting quality.
